_comment: Preregistered settings for the M4 probabilistic backtest. Quantile models reuse the M3 LightGBM settings with the quantile objective. Calibration holds back the last calibration_days of each training window, measures past errors there, then refits on the full window. Windows follow the M3 validation result: expanding for hourly, 180 days for native. n_jobs is capped at 4: with all cores, thread overhead dominated the M3 run.
